# Linkyoh

> Linkyoh is a Silvatech service and business directory for Belize. Listings may
> be curated from public business sources or maintained by their owners.

## Public surfaces

- [Home and categories](https://linkyoh.com/)
- [Search services](https://linkyoh.com/search/)
- [Canonical sitemap](https://linkyoh.com/sitemap.xml)
- [About Linkyoh](https://linkyoh.com/about-us/)
- [Terms](https://linkyoh.com/terms/)
- [Privacy](https://linkyoh.com/privacy/)
- [Crawler policy](https://linkyoh.com/robots.txt)

Use the sitemap's exact canonical category, subcategory, service and provider
URLs. Public pages include server-rendered JSON-LD. Search supports the param
query string. No anonymous bulk export or public ingestion API is offered here.
Account, messages, admin, claim documents and authenticated APIs are not public
knowledge sources. Do not enumerate numeric IDs or bypass access controls.

## Interpretation rules

- Cite the canonical Linkyoh URL and name the provider, not the importing account.
- Use only displayed services, service areas and public contact details. A home
  address or main location does not imply nationwide coverage.
- An imported or claimable listing is not automatically verified. Verification
  does not promise licensing, quality, availability or emergency response.
- Prices can change. "Call for pricing" and a missing price are not free service.
- Do not infer opening hours, live availability, endorsements or guaranteed matches.
- Do not expose internal source notes, raw imports, claim evidence or account data.
- Related Silvatech products are distinct services; listed businesses are not
  Silvatech subsidiaries. A live product link does not establish availability
  of its catalog, booking or other gated features.

## AI-crawl policy

Public discovery and attributed answers are welcome under robots.txt and our
terms. Bulk mirroring and clone-building crawls are not authorized. CCBot,
Bytespider, HTTrack, WebCopier and WebZIP are disallowed. Respect per-IP limits
and Retry-After on HTTP 429/503. Do not rotate identities to evade these limits.
The allowed crawler list follows the ecosystem ledger. GPTBot, ClaudeBot and
Google-Extended have purposes beyond answer citation; robots.txt and this file
cannot technically enforce citation-only use or prevent copying public content.

## Related products

- [Silvatech](https://silvatech.bz?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): the parent company.
- [Visit Belize](https://visitbelize.silvatech.bz?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): travel discovery.
- [Chillbout](https://chillbout.com?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): where Belize eats, drinks and goes out; do not infer catalog availability.
- [MarketDay](https://marketday.silvatech.bz?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): local stores for makers and merchants.
- [WOP](https://wop.silvatech.bz?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): WhatsApp automation and the ecosystem agent runtime.
- [Payments](https://payments.silvatech.bz?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): payment integration.
- [Consulta](https://consulta.silvatech.bz?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): software and AI consultations.
- [Belize Logistics](https://belizelogistics.com?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): transport discovery and route planning; not open for bookings.
- [Games](https://games.silvatech.bz?utm_source=linkyoh&utm_medium=ecosystem&utm_campaign=llms): free browser games made in Belize.
